# Unbounded PR and Commit Retrieval

The implementation limits the number of PRs and commits retrieved to 1000 per reconcile. If this limit is exceeded, information may be lost or ignored, potentially leading to incomplete data processing.

- `knowledge_compiler/collectors/forge.py` — `knowledge_compiler.collectors.forge.GitHubGateway.list_merged_prs`
